game_title: Logic Detective – Buried Temple Steps Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Logic Detective: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Trace code that runs but gives the wrong answer and fix the logic bug. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the clues value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the camel pen using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The camel pen reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the camel pen is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Logic Detective
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
